title: Current xdrip watchfaces do not support sound
symptom: A few AW2.0 watches have a speaker now and it would be nice that the speaker can be used for alerting like in the xdrip+ app. Most smartwatches have a weak vibration alert/notification which does not wake you up. Now a phone is still needed for sound alerts.
fix: Enable the on-watch notifications and the sound feature via xDrip preferences on the watch face, as suggested in the Aug 19th Nightly.
evidence_quote: Then you need to enable the on-watch notifications and the sound feature - both via xDrip preferences on the watch face.
